build_pointnet2_cuda_extension: build the pointnet2 CUDA extension by running pip install in the pointnet2 directory
build_pointnet2_ext_module: build the pointnet2._ext module with O3 optimization for both CXX and NVCC compilers
install_pointnet2_from_source: install the pointnet2 package from source using python setup.py build_ext in place
review_setup_cuda_compile_args: review the setup.py extra compile args for CXX and NVCC optimization flags
summarize_pointnet2_setup: summarize the pointnet2 setup.py which configures a CUDAExtension with globbed C++ and CUDA sources
